primarySourceChecks.text: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.
primarySourceChecks.reasonJa: この節の記載は対象集団/人物関係を明記。

primarySourceChecks.text: The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
primarySourceChecks.reasonJa: この節の記載は対象集団/人物関係を明記。

primarySourceChecks.text: But when the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.
primarySourceChecks.reasonJa: この節の記載は対象集団/人物関係を明記。

primarySourceChecks.text: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.
primarySourceChecks.reasonJa: この節の記載は対象集団/人物関係を明記。

primarySourceChecks.text: He said to them, “Follow me; for the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.
primarySourceChecks.reasonJa: この節の記載は対象集団/人物関係を明記。

primarySourceChecks.text: They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.
primarySourceChecks.reasonJa: この節の記載は対象集団/人物関係を明記。

primarySourceChecks.text: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.
primarySourceChecks.reasonJa: この節の記載は対象集団/人物関係を明記。

primarySourceChecks.text: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and served the Baals, the Ashtaroth, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines. They abandoned the LORD, and didn’t serve him.
primarySourceChecks.reasonJa: この節の記載は対象集団/人物関係を明記。

primarySourceChecks.text: and he said to him, “Jephthah says: Israel didn’t take away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon;

primarySourceChecks.text: then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Please let me pass through your land;’ but the king of Edom didn’t listen. In the same way, he sent to the king of Moab, but he refused; so Israel stayed in Kadesh.

primarySourceChecks.text: Then they went through the wilderness, and went around the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and they encamped on the other side of the Arnon; but they didn’t come within the border of Moab, for the Arnon was the border of Moab.
